notes.title: [Dev Log] 2017.12.30 Night Nemo_D.O
notes.content:
last 2 month ago,  GGHF announced a 31th December launch date for Nemo_D.O, 
Passing through the season of 2017
I am developer of GGHF, it is not enough, but it comes to cheer me.
also exhibited at BIC ( Busan Indie Connect Festival )  of Korea 2017.
Steam 2017 Early Access (40% off sale) is also started  with Winter sales(-40%)

@GGHF makes 'Nemo_D.O on Steam . And we are continuing develop to February 2018.


[h1]News of 30th December 2017 [/h1]
[b]# Coregame rule: 
the one character collects bullets, the other shoots bullets' is an original concept[/b]
The game in which two robots move and shot at the same time for accomplish mission by manipulating the divided screens.
 
This game has  two modes  Singleplayer & Multiplayer.

However, there are some Update news that I am working on, 
Let see Update items check belows:  

[h1](1) Adding 2:2 Multiplayer mode and new theme[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30367512/89ef33a22da6af4559aea82729e6165f9eabdcc8.png[/img]
We are creating a new theme, wastelands. Here is a 2: 2 multiplayer match.

GGHF would prefer if multiplayer was also like single player: fight 1v1 against bot, then 1v2, 1v3 or something like that
                  
[h1](2)  improved multiplayer mode rules:  special Lightning Bullet button [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30367512/a393308d865f3f7229f9169d45bf478bb8afb52a.gif[/img]

- If your opponent's skill is great or you want to finish the game at once,
With the help of special weapons, great weapons are fired and you can control your opponent instantly.

 
[h1](3) multiplayer modes  and improved rules:  five blast Missle[/h1]
- When 1 vs 1 warfare fires a bullet from a melee, live blast missile (?!) Is fired.
If the enemy squad hides behind the wall or tries to trick you, try this missile.

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30367512/9642b105e3d4d402243ce7407d7e9cd34dd3af9e.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30367512/7e3df26c16abd6dca55569aa7575617605980d2d.png[/img][/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30367512/fff2276feb658f1130e9e021d9a32b562dc10a7f.png[/img]
  Nemo_D.O are currently working on the above and new things in official release 

GGHF want to share with gamers much more at home and abroad.
Once you see the video below, I would like to talk to you if you like.
Thank you.

team.gghf@gmail.com
https://gghf.itch.io/nemo-do

notes.title: [Dev Log] 2017.11.08 afternoon
notes.content:
[url]https://gghf.itch.io/nemo-do[/url]
[h1]Hi. this is Nemo_D.O developer.
I am currently working on it by October 10th, but I can not get a big result.
[/h1]
I apologize for not keeping promise.

November 8, 2017, Nemo_D.O are working on the stuffs below.

[b] (1) Multiplayer mode: 1 new theme and improved rules [/b]
- When 1: 1 warfare fires a bullet from a melee, a circle wave missile (?!) Is fired.
If the enemy squad hides behind the wall or tries to trick you, try this missile.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30367512/fff2276feb658f1130e9e021d9a32b562dc10a7f.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30367512/9642b105e3d4d402243ce7407d7e9cd34dd3af9e.png[/img]
[b] (2) Steam Achievements [/b]
We are currently testing.

[b] (3) Steam Trading Card [/b]
We will show it after the official launch.

[b] (4) I am currently looking for a bug. [/b]
For crashes or critical bugs, please contact the Game Page Discussion Board 

team.gghf@gmail.com.
※ Nemo_D.O will be officially released before the end of 2017.
